in_sanskrit.name: Tenzin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector of Dharma
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tenzin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Tenzin is derived from the Tibetan words 'bod' meaning 'protector' and 'tsen' meaning 'dharma' or 'law'. This name is given to individuals born into the Tibetan Buddhist tradition and is considered to be a protector of the dharma, or religious teachings.
